Created the brick-breaker game in [index.html](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t2_r2/work/index.html) with all requested features:

- **5 Distinct Levels**: Five unique brick layouts (`LEVEL_LAYOUTS`). Clearing all bricks advances to the next level, and clearing level 5 displays `"You win"`.
- **Lives & Game Over**: Starts with 3 lives; losing the ball deducts a life and displays `"Game over"` at 0 lives.
- **Scoring & Status Bar**: Breaking bricks adds points to the score and updates the best score, displaying `"Score: N"`, `"Lives: N"`, `"Level: N"`, and `"Best: N"`.
- **Pause & Shortcuts**: Press `P` to toggle pause (`"Paused"` screen, freezing all movement) and `N` to skip to the next level.
- **Persistent Progress**: Saves and restores both the current level and best score using `localStorage`.
- **Controls**: Move the paddle with the left/right arrow keys or mouse, and press `Space` or click to launch the ball.
